text: Figure 7.5: Data Communication Graph with Fan-In, local RIPS and Local Providers In 7.5 the RTE has three potential values to choose from when ascertaining how to fill a buffer based on last is best semantics: the local provider, the value from the local RIPS plugin or the value from the cross cluster RIPS plugin. Again, the RTE has no way of knowing which value arrived last so cannot implement this communication pattern.
